description: The body of an OpenSearch _search request, narrowed to the top-level keys Synapse accepts. Each slot's contents are pass-through OpenSearch query DSL; see the search REST endpoint for the inner-clause allowlist, field-reference rules, pagination semantics, and per-request limits.

query.description: Required. The OpenSearch query DSL clause. Use {"match_all":{}} to match all documents. See Query for the full set of supported clause kinds, and query vs. filter context.

post_filter.description: Optional. Same DSL shape as query (see Query), applied after aggregations are computed. For the distinction between filtering hits and filtering aggregations, see query vs. filter context.

aggregations.description: Optional. Map of caller-chosen name to aggregation definition. The raw aggregation result comes back on SearchQueryResults.aggregationResults. For the facet-counting pattern (a terms aggregation alongside post_filter), see the faceted search tutorial.

highlight.description: Optional. Adds per-field snippet fragments (matched terms wrapped in <em> / </em> tags by default) to each SearchQueryResults.hits[*].highlights entry.

collapse.description: Optional. Groups the result list so only one hit is returned per distinct value of field.

rescore.description: Optional. Re-ranks the top window_size hits returned by query using a secondary scoring query.

sort.description: Optional. Result ordering, in native OpenSearch sort shape (a string column name, {column: "asc|desc"}, or {column: {order: ..., mode: ..., missing: ...}}) applied in order. Only the field and _score sort kinds are accepted — script and geo-distance sorts are rejected server-side. The pseudo-column _score sorts by relevance. When omitted, results are sorted by relevance descending. Ties are broken by row ID ascending, except when rescore is supplied.

_source.description: Optional. Source filter selecting which columns are returned on each hit.

from.description: Optional. Zero-based pagination offset; default 0. Ignored when search_after is supplied (the cursor determines the page start).

size.description: Optional. Maximum number of hits to return per page. Default: 25. Maximum: 100 (larger values are silently capped).

search_after.description: Optional. Opaque cursor emitted as nextSearchAfter on the previous response. Pass back unchanged. When supplied, from is ignored.
